title: Full cohomological dimension zero for identity
statement: Let $s$ be any scheme and $A$ any finite commutative ring. In the intrinsic constant-ring module derived categories of [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], the identity morphism has full cohomological dimension zero: $\operatorname{FullCD}(\operatorname{id}_s,A;0)$ in [def-weil-full-cohomological-dimension]. Both clauses apply to every module sheaf, and the second to every pro-etale test object, without finite-type or constructibility restrictions.

source.place: identity-adjunction sentence, expanded in parent steps 1--2 (FullCD) and 3--5, 8 (support normalization)

proof.text: For an isomorphism f, conjugate the fixed-scalar pro-etale lowerStar equivalence through the canonical coefficient realization. The section-normalized direct-image comparison yields an equivalence for the actual intrinsic direct image. This is directImage_isEquivalence in Lean.

An equivalence is exact, so its right derived functor agrees with its exact termwise descent. The singleFunctor comparison identifies the image of F[0] with (f_*F)[0]. The standard t-structure therefore gives zero cohomology in every positive degree. This is positive_directImage_single.

Apply the preceding argument to id_s and to the second projection from the pullback of id_s along each pro-etale object V. Both morphisms are isomorphisms. In the second application use the specified pullback of F as the sheaf in degree zero. Conjunction introduction gives the two FullCD clauses.
